name: reconcile_tables
representative_why: Users need to compare planned, actual, and imported data sets to find mismatches.
concrete_workflows: compare planned budget categories with actual expense exports
compare inventory movement balances with stock master on-hand values
verification_strategy: Supported scope verifies explicit left/right key matching, explicit compare mappings, matched rows, left-only rows, right-only rows, value mismatches, source preservation, and lookup sheet preservation. Fuzzy matching, duplicate-key resolution, tolerances, and many-to-many reconciliation remain outside supported scope.
notes: Promoted into the supported public capability registry after Phase 10 runtime contract, executor, verifier, workbookcase, and open-layer structured request coverage.
